name: RealWeb: A Benchmark for Universal Instruction Following in Realistic Web Services Navigation
notes: The annotation was reviewed against the IEEE Xplore abstract page, the Crossref-deposited citation and the authors' Gitee repository README. The abstract counts 110 pages and names the baseline WeServe, reporting a 68.61% success rate; the README counts 119 pages across 15 domains. At the inspected commit the repository's Codes folder holds only a placeholder file, while the dataset files are present. No arXiv version was found.
summary: Introduces RealWeb, a Chinese benchmark of 11,739 instructions on 40 real websites with annotated screenshots and slot trees, plus a baseline that detects page regions, parses instructions and acts on the pages.
